title.legacy.farmer.desc: The land remembers those who tend it.
title.legacy.grossbauer.desc: Field after field bends to your patience.
title.legacy.landwirt.desc: Seasons turn, and still you sow.
title.legacy.gruene_hand.desc: Life follows wherever your hand passes.
title.legacy.viehzuechter.desc: The herd grows under a steady hand.
title.legacy.schaefer.desc: They follow the sound of your voice.
title.legacy.hirte.desc: A whole valley answers to you.
title.legacy.blumenpfluecker.desc: You leave meadows a little emptier, a little brighter.
title.legacy.blumenmeister.desc: Every color of the world has passed through your hands.
title.legacy.holzhacker.desc: The first tree always falls the hardest.
title.legacy.foerster.desc: You take only what the forest can spare.
title.legacy.schuerfer.desc: The first stone is always the hardest.
title.legacy.bergmann.desc: The mountain opens for those who persist.
title.legacy.tiefengraeber.desc: You have gone where light forgets to follow.
title.legacy.prospektor.desc: You read the veins in the stone.
title.legacy.erzsucher.desc: The deep gives up its treasures to you.
title.legacy.heart_of_the_mountains.desc: Down where the world keeps its oldest secrets.
title.legacy.fortunes_favorite.desc: The stone glittered, and it chose you.
title.legacy.relic_seeker.desc: Older than the Nether, and you found it.
title.legacy.reisender.desc: The road is longer than any map.
title.legacy.entdecker.desc: The blank spaces on the map grow few.
title.legacy.weltenentdecker.desc: You have seen what most will only imagine.
title.legacy.deep_roots.desc: Where the earth blooms in the dark.
title.legacy.crimson_wanderer.desc: You walked among the red groves and returned.
title.legacy.ashen.desc: The valley of souls left its mark.
title.legacy.shadow_touched.desc: Something in the dark noticed you.
title.legacy.hellwalker.desc: You crossed into fire and kept walking.
title.legacy.beyond_horizon.desc: At the edge of everything, you took one more step.
title.legacy.long_road.desc: Step by step, the world grew small behind you.
title.legacy.skyborne.desc: The ground is just a place you visit now.
title.legacy.aspirant.desc: Your first duel is behind you.
title.legacy.scout.desc: You have learned to read an opponent.
title.legacy.bezwinger.desc: Your name is spoken with caution.
title.legacy.warbound.desc: War is not what you do. It is what you are.
title.legacy.reaper.desc: The count of the fallen no longer troubles you.
title.legacy.endermans_bane.desc: You have met their gaze and won.
title.legacy.emberheart.desc: Fire holds no fear for you.
title.legacy.terror_of_the_seas.desc: The drowned fear the shallows where you wait.
title.legacy.dragonslayer.desc: The sky itself fell before you.
title.legacy.wyrmsbane.desc: Once was chance. Thrice is a legend.
title.legacy.withers_bane.desc: You unmade what should not have been made.
title.legacy.tidebreaker.desc: The ancient watcher watches no more.
title.legacy.unseen.desc: You faced what hunts by sound, and lived.
title.legacy.pluendererjaeger.desc: The banners fall wherever you ride.
title.legacy.haendler.desc: A fair bargain is never forgotten.
title.legacy.beschuetzer.desc: The bells ring safe because of you.
title.legacy.held_des_dorfes.desc: They will tell your story for generations.
title.legacy.enchanter.desc: The old words come easily to you now.
title.legacy.schildtraeger.desc: You have learned to let blows break upon you.
title.legacy.unerschuetterlich.desc: The storm breaks; you do not.
title.legacy.bootsmann.desc: You have made peace with the water.
title.legacy.seefahrer.desc: No shore is too far now.
title.legacy.navigator.desc: You read the currents like a page.
title.legacy.old_guard.desc: You were here before most of this world.
title.legacy.timeless.desc: Worlds have risen and fallen. You remain.
title.legacy.touched_by_fate.desc: Some paths are not walked. They are chosen for you.
